title: filter() and mutate()
instructions: Load the `dplyr` package. Using the built-in `mtcars` dataset, filter cars with `mpg > 20` and add a new column `kpl` (kilometres per litre) by multiplying `mpg` by `0.425`.
starterCode:
library(dplyr)

# Filter and add a new column
result <- mtcars |>
  filter(___) |>
  mutate(kpl = ___)
print(head(result))
